title: Mbombela Stadium
visualBrief: Specific Mbombela Stadium: own mapped clipped rectangular body, larger mapped roof aperture/independent pitch axis, eighteen orange giraffe mast silhouettes with near lattice/short head members/closed lower fins/attached roof stays, closed pale-grey/cream faceted canopy/renderable underside/deep inner truss/radial lattice/open stand-to-roof ventilation gap, ten approximate concrete access cores/neutral recessed glazing-services/concourse bands, four green curved two-turn access ramps with closed floors/guards/approach links/supports, three zebra-pattern seating bands/two closed circulation belts/pale aisles/open neutral football floor and supported displays/lights/goals. Four existing shared concrete/paint/canvas/window-grid graphs; no bespoke texture atlas/copied seating bitmap/logos/hidden furnished rooms. Far levels merge repeated detail, retain mast/head identity and use solid ramp masses/expanded simplified seating aperture.
